name: Agent Launcher
author: modpunk (omarchy.fans)
description: Spin up an AI agent (Hermes Agent or OpenClaw) from a keybinding: pick the agent, where it runs (local shell, Docker, or a Fly.io Sprite), the model and how to sign in (browser OAuth or API key), the skills to preload, and the job it should carry out. Each agent gets its own isolated profile.

barWidget.description: One click opens the agent launcher form in a floating terminal.
